label: Google Drive
description: Pull 3D models, textures, and audio straight from Google Drive into UEFN. One-click 'Sign in with Google' (read-only), point it at one Drive folder you drop assets into, and Ducky downloads them safely (allowlisted types, size caps, nothing executed) and imports them as ready-to-use assets.

settings.sections.title: Sign in with Google
settings.sections.description: Just ask your ducky to "connect Google Drive" — a Google sign-in opens in your browser, you pick your account and approve read-only access, and that's it. Nothing to paste. The app only ever receives a read-only token (stored encrypted on this device); your password never touches it. Say "disconnect Google Drive" to sign out.

settings.sections.title: Your Drive folder
settings.sections.description: Optional but handy: paste the link (or id) of one Drive folder where you keep assets. Then "list my Drive" / "search my Drive" default to that folder, so you just drop models into it and ask Ducky to pull them. Leave blank to browse your whole Drive.

properties.label: Drive folder link or id
properties.description: Right-click the folder in Google Drive → Share → Copy link, and paste it here. Everything you drop in that folder becomes pullable into UEFN.

settings.sections.title: Downloads
settings.sections.description: Files land in the app's staging folder (AppData → downloads/googledrive) and are imported into UEFN from there. Only model/texture/audio/zip files are ever downloaded; zips are extracted with the same allowlist; nothing is executed.

properties.label: Max download size
properties.description: Hard cap per file (and 2× this for a zip's extracted contents).

settings.sections.title: Advanced (optional)
settings.sections.description: You do not need any of this for normal use. Use your own Google Cloud project only if you'd rather not use the built-in sign-in: paste a Desktop-app OAuth Client ID + secret to override it. An API key lets you browse public 'anyone with link' folders without signing in at all.

properties.label: OAuth Client ID (override)
properties.description: From your own Google Cloud project (Desktop app client). Overrides the built-in sign-in.

properties.label: OAuth Client secret (override)
properties.description: Shown next to the Client ID when you create it.

properties.label: Google API key
properties.description: Optional. Only needed to browse public folders without signing in.

steps.title: Google Drive setup
steps.body: Connect Drive and point at a folder of assets. Press Google Drive to open settings.

steps.title: You're set
steps.body: Ask the agent to connect Google Drive (browser sign-in), set an optional folder link, then pull models/textures/audio into UEFN.
